# intent bearer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intentBearer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent in whom a desire or intention inheres. Functional: an intrinsic mode has exactly one bearer ([gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) inherence, asserted with GMEOW's own property by [Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5) — [gufo:inheresIn](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#inheresIn) is the alignment target, not the asserted axiom). Two agents wanting the same goal are two modes sharing one [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](gmeow-intentionGoal.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md) from [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)

```turtle
# --- The intention: an intentional mode borne by Dana, aimed at the goal, that
#     motivates a concrete action (the graduation event).
ex:intention a gmeow:Intention ;
    gmeow:intentBearer  ex:dana ;
    gmeow:intentionGoal ex:degreeGoal ;
    gmeow:motivates     ex:graduation .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single agent in whom a [`Desire`](../classes/gmeow-Desire.md) or [`Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md) inheres — the bearer side of the intrinsic branch.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the social branch (a [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) binds its agent with [`gmeow:committedAgent`](gmeow-committedAgent.md)) and avoid asserting two bearers; the property is functional, so two agents wanting the same goal are two modes sharing one [`gmeow:intentionGoal`](gmeow-intentionGoal.md).

### How to use

- Point the [`IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) at exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); read [gufo:inheresIn](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#inheresIn) as the alignment target rather than asserting it ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)).

### Examples

- ex:wishForRain [`gmeow:intentBearer`](gmeow-intentBearer.md) ex:lillith.
